description: Online events, by day in the viewer's time zone. The /online page: every published online or hybrid event whose next date falls in the next 30 days (from today in tz), filtered by craft, time of day (tod), day, free and language (lang), all judged in the viewer's zone (tz), and grouped by the viewer's own start date. At most 200 events are read; `truncated` says more exist. Time of day and day are worked out per event from its own start time and zone, which is why they live here and not on GET /api/events (online=1 there lists online events by their own dates, paged).

craft.description: Comma list of top-level craft slugs (any of); unknown slugs are ignored.

day.description: today, week (the next 7 days) or weekend (this or the coming Fri to Sun), in tz.

lang.description: One language code (en, es): only events known to be held in it. Without it every language shows, the caller's Accept-Language ranked first within each day.

tod.description: Comma list of morning (5 am to noon), afternoon (noon to 5 pm), evening (5 pm to 5 am), judged in tz; an event with no start time never matches one.

tz.description: The viewer's IANA time zone; days and times of day are judged in it. Default America/New_York.

name: list_online_events
title: Online events, by day in the viewer's time zone
